greeting.speaker: Ganel
text: Three of you. I expected an army, or at least a bribe.
You walked up the hill in the open. Either that's confidence or you've never done this before.
My lookout said soldiers. You're not soldiers. Soldiers get paid.

options.text: You expected the wrong valley. Stand down or be put down.
Your men haven't eaten in three days. I can smell it on the camp.
Who put you in this valley? You didn't choose it.
Shove past his guard and take the high ground now.
A hundred gold, and the valley never hears your name again.

again.speaker: Ganel
text: You. I've had a month to think of what to say to you, and it's all gone.
Word came up the valley before you did. I let it. I wanted to see which version was true.
Back on my hill. You'll understand if nobody offers you a seat.

options.text: Last time was talk. This time isn't.
You took my coin and you're still here.
Your camp is thinner than it was. Some of them walked.

defiance.speaker: Ganel
defiance.text: Then take the high ground, sworn blade. You'll want it.

starving.speaker: Ganel
starving.text: Hungry men fight harder. But they hold a line worse. Come and see.

cowed.speaker: Ganel
cowed.text: Steady. You've made your point in front of my whole camp, and that will cost one of us.

laughed_off.speaker: Ganel
laughed_off.text: Try that again when you've grown into your armour. Weapons up — the rest is talk.

bribe.speaker: Ganel
bribe.text: Generous. I'll spend it on the widows of whoever you kill getting up this hill.

the_man_above.speaker: Ganel
the_man_above.text: ...Somebody with a seal ring told us which road to sit on and which carts to leave alone. Work out who that helps, and you'll know why I don't say his name.

the_debt.speaker: Ganel
the_debt.text: I said the valley wouldn't hear my name. It hasn't. You're the one who came looking for it.

thinner.speaker: Ganel
thinner.text: Eleven of them, after they heard what you did. Cost me nothing to lose the ones who scare easy. That's what I tell the rest.
